items.abstract: <jats:p>We propose a quantum temporal convolutional neural network (QTCNN) for cross-sectional equity return prediction under a realistic stock ranking workflow. The model combines a classical temporal encoder with parameterefficient quantum convolution and pooling layers, then fuses quantum outputs with classical features for final prediction. Using the JPX Tokyo Stock Exchange benchmark, we compare QTCNN against strong classical and quantum baselines and evaluate performance under long-short portfolio metrics. Results indicate competitive predictive robustness and improved risk-adjusted performance across multiple experimental settings.</jats:p>
title: Quantum Temporal Convolutional Neural Networks for Cross-Sectional Equity Return Prediction: A Comparative Benchmark Study
